observations: Front/side/back/hero, final masked and unmasked front/profile portraits and pose-contact-sheet inspected against actual original090/060.
Wider stance and more defined chin/neck transitions support progress, but geometry and facial likeness remain materially below source fidelity.
Manual bone-center stance ratios are supporting measurements, not exact correspondence to painted garment landmarks.

remainingDefects.finding: The unmasked portrait is a simplified stylized face rather than source090 likeness: slit-like eyes, broad smooth cheeks, straight mouth line and shallow nose/jaw anatomy. Hair is evenly repeated thick strips with exposed cap areas; source hair has irregular clumps and directional overlap.
remainingDefects.repair: Rebuild eye sockets/lids, nose and lip volumes, cheek/jaw planes and irregular hair masses from original front/profile panels.

remainingDefects.finding: Broad curved orange lames project as separated smooth bands; source chest panels are fitted, flatter and bordered with straps/rivets. Cape is smooth with a tall plain collar; source drapes/folds, buckle anchor and underlayers differ. Rectangular bracer lacks the rounded ceramic casing and latch detail.
remainingDefects.repair: Fit chest panels to torso, author individual edges/fasteners and cape folds, and build rounded bracer shell/latch from060 detail panels.

remainingDefects.finding: Trouser folds, pocket transitions, straight shin guards and boot straps/foot yaw remain simplified. Gray cloth and smooth orange ceramic lack soot-black weave, porous terracotta and weathered iron.
remainingDefects.repair: Refine garment volumes and boot construction before localized material wear and microdetail.

remainingDefects.finding: Contact sheet demonstrates candidate pose changes but does not reproduce source060 shoulder/elbow/knee flexion diagnostics or establish cloth/armor clearance.
remainingDefects.repair: Add matched clearance poses and close views after primary geometry repair.

limits: Pixel review and file-identity verification only; no duplicated import/engine or clearance tests.
